comment: Identical architectures made optimizer progress the main discriminator. K1001/K1002 gave nominal displacements B=.768, A=.096, C=E=.0256, D=.00096, correctly separating the major groups at this short budget. K1070 supplied the RMSprop-over-Adam tie-break for C versus E on an underfit classification network. K1012 cautioned against treating close cross-optimizer displacement estimates as decisive, but no architecture differences complicated this case. The gold ranking supports these existing scoped rules; it adds no new general rule.
